name: Hang glider
definition: unpowered, foot-launched glider with a rigid frame under a fabric wing, steered by the pilot's weight shift.

name: Paraglider
definition: Unpowered, foot-launched glider with a flexible fabric wing hung on lines. A powered paraglider is in Vehicles.

name: Free-flight harness
definition: harness that suspends and carries the pilot under a hang glider or paraglider.

name: Traction kite
definition: steerable kite made to pull a rider on land (on a buggy, board or skis) or to train for kite sports.

name: Skydiving parachute
definition: Canopy, container and harness system for descending from an aircraft, including skydiving rigs.

name: Ballet shoe
definition: soft, flexible slipper made for ballet practice and performance.

name: Pointe shoe
definition: ballet shoe with a stiffened box and shank for dancing on the tips of the toes.

name: Tap shoe
definition: dance shoe with metal plates at toe and heel that sound the steps.

name: Dance practice wear
definition: Clothing made for dance practice rather than everyday wear. Everyday dance-style clothing is in Clothing.

name: Athletics hurdle
definition: barrier on a base that athletes clear in hurdle races, height-adjustable to the race standard.

name: Starting block
definition: pair of angled foot plates fixed to the track that sprinters push off at the start.

name: Starting pistol
definition: Blank-firing pistol made to start races. One made for self-defence is in Weapons & Armour.

name: Track spike
definition: lightweight running shoe with a spike plate made for track competition.

name: Climbing harness
definition: Sit harness with leg loops and a belay loop that ties the climber into the rope; the UIAA or EN standard is noted where it is met.

name: Climbing helmet
definition: helmet made for climbing and mountaineering against falling objects and falls, certified to the UIAA or EN climbing-helmet standard.

name: Climbing rope
definition: dynamic or static kernmantle rope made for climbing, rated to UIAA 101 or its EN equivalent.

name: Climbing shoe
definition: tight-fitting shoe with a sticky rubber sole and rand made for climbing rock or walls.

name: Navigation compass
definition: Magnetic compass made for finding your way on foot (baseplate, thumb or sighting compass). A drawing compass is in Office & Stationery.

name: Map case
definition: waterproof transparent case that holds a map for use outdoors.

name: Airsoft gun
definition: Replica gun that fires plastic BB pellets by spring, gas or electric power, made for airsoft play.

name: Paintball hopper
definition: feed container mounted on a paintball marker that holds the paintballs and feeds them to it.

name: Paintball gun
definition: compressed-gas gun that fires paint-filled balls, made for paintball play.

name: Paintball mask
definition: full-face mask with a goggle lens made to protect the eyes and face from paintballs or airsoft pellets.

name: Boxing glove
definition: padded glove worn for boxing sparring, bagwork or competition.

name: Fencing foil
definition: light thrusting fencing weapon with a flexible rectangular blade, made to FIE rules for the foil.

name: Fencing epee
definition: thrusting fencing weapon with a stiff triangular blade and a large bell guard, made to FIE rules for the epee.

name: Fencing sabre
definition: Cutting and thrusting fencing weapon with a knuckle guard, made to FIE rules. The sabre sword is in Weapons & Armour.

name: Fencing mask
definition: Mesh mask with a bib that protects a fencer's face, head and neck; the FIE 1600 N bib is noted where it is met.

name: Fencing jacket
definition: protective jacket made for fencing, rated to a puncture resistance such as FIE 800 N.

name: Judo uniform
definition: Heavy cotton jacket and trousers made for judo grips and throws.

name: Bokken
definition: solid wooden sword made for kendo and other Japanese sword-art practice.

name: Kendo armour
definition: protective armour set made for kendo (head guard, gloves, breastplate and waist guard).

name: Shinai
definition: practice sword of bamboo or carbon staves made for kendo sparring.

name: Wushu practice weapon
definition: Blunt or unsharpened wushu sword, broadsword, staff or spear made for practice or competition.

name: HEMA training sword
definition: Blunt steel or synthetic sword made for sparring and drills in historical European martial arts (HEMA).

name: HEMA fencing jacket
definition: Padded jacket made for HEMA, rated to a puncture resistance such as 350 N or 800 N where certified.

name: HEMA protective gloves
definition: Padded or plated gloves that protect the hands from sword blows in HEMA sparring.

name: Cycling shoe
definition: Stiff-soled shoe made for cycling, usually with a cleat fitting for clipless pedals.

name: Padded cycling shorts
definition: close-fitting shorts with a sewn-in chamois pad made for riding a bicycle.

name: Riding hat
definition: Helmet made for horse riding, certified to an equestrian helmet standard.

name: Inline skate
definition: boot with a single line of wheels in a frame, made for skating.

name: Ski goggles
definition: Goggles made for skiing and snowboarding against glare, wind and snow.

name: Ski helmet
definition: Helmet made for skiing and snowboarding.

name: Alpine ski
definition: Ski made for downhill skiing with a fixed-heel binding; use class, width and turning radius vary.

name: Ski boot
definition: Rigid plastic-shell boot made to drive an alpine or touring ski through the binding; stiffness is rated on the maker's scale.

name: Cross-country ski
definition: long, narrow ski made for Nordic touring or racing with a free-heel binding.

name: Ice skate
definition: boot with a steel blade made for skating on ice.

name: Touring ski
definition: Light ski made for climbing with skins and then skiing down, used with a touring binding and boot.

name: Snowboard
definition: single wide board ridden sideways down snow with both feet bound to it.

name: Ski bag
definition: Bag that carries one pair of skis. A bag for several pieces is in Bags & Accessories.

name: Ski binding
definition: binding that fixes a boot to a ski and releases it in a fall.

name: Baseball glove
definition: padded leather glove or mitt made for catching in baseball or softball.

name: Cricket ball
definition: hard, leather-covered cork-core ball with a raised seam, made for cricket.

name: Cricket bat
definition: Flat-faced willow bat made for cricket; willow grade 1 to 4 is a retailer convention.

name: Football
definition: Inflated ball made for association football; comes in sizes.

name: Rugby ball
definition: Oval inflated ball made for rugby; comes in official-ball classes and sizes.

name: Competition swimsuit
definition: Racing suit made for competitive swimming. Bikinis, trunks and beachwear are in Clothing.

name: Surfboard
definition: board ridden standing on breaking waves.

name: Kitesurf kite
definition: large steerable kite made to pull a rider on a board across water.

name: Bodyboard
definition: short foam board ridden lying prone on waves.

name: Stand-up paddleboard
definition: large board ridden standing and propelled with a paddle, rigid or inflatable.

name: Mouthguard
definition: moulded guard worn over the teeth to protect them in contact sports.

name: Knee pad
definition: padded guard worn over the knee to protect it in sport.

name: Shin guard
definition: rigid or padded guard worn over the shin in sport.

name: Swim goggles
definition: Watertight goggles made for swimming.

name: Distress flare
definition: Pyrotechnic flare that signals distress by light or smoke.

name: Gymnastic rings
definition: pair of rings hung on straps for gymnastic and bodyweight training.

name: Punch bag
definition: heavy hanging or free-standing bag struck in boxing and fitness training.

name: Skipping rope
definition: rope with handles turned and jumped over in training.

name: Crampon
definition: spiked frame fitted to a boot for grip on ice and hard snow.

name: Ice axe
definition: axe with a pick and adze made for climbing and travel on snow and ice.

name: Golf bag
definition: Bag that carries one set of golf clubs.

name: Table tennis rubber
definition: Rubber sheet, with or without sponge, glued to a table tennis bat; the surface is inverted, pimples-out or long pimples.

name: Tennis string
definition: string sold to string a tennis racket, by the set or the reel.

name: Sledge
definition: Unpowered sled or toboggan ridden downhill on snow or ice for play or sport. A horse-drawn or machine-drawn sleigh is in Vehicles.

name: Snowshoe
definition: wide frame strapped to a boot to walk on deep snow.

name: Baseball bat
definition: Rounded bat made for baseball or softball; comes in hard-ball and soft-ball types and in different materials.

name: Football boot
definition: Studded or bladed boot made for football; the ground type it suits (FG, AG, SG, MG, TF, IC) is marked on it.

name: Kick scooter
definition: Unpowered scooter with a deck and handlebar, pushed along by foot. A powered kick scooter is in Vehicles.

name: Skateboard
definition: Unpowered board on two trucks and four wheels, ridden standing. A powered board is in Vehicles.

name: Unicycle
definition: Unpowered single-wheel cycle pedalled and balanced by the rider. An electric unicycle is in Vehicles.

name: Wetsuit
definition: Neoprene suit that insulates the wearer in water, for surfing, diving, triathlon and paddling; comes in different thicknesses.

name: Diving mask
definition: mask with a glass lens and nose pocket made for diving and snorkelling.

name: Wing-foil wing
definition: hand-held inflatable wing that powers a rider on a foil board.

name: Flare pistol
definition: Pistol made to fire distress or signal flares.

name: Racket case
definition: Case or cover that holds one racket.

name: Fishing rod
definition: Flexible rod made to cast and play a fish on a line; comes in different powers and actions.

name: Hunting decoy
definition: Model or replica of a bird or animal set out to lure game within range.

name: Game call
definition: Device blown, struck or played electronically that imitates an animal's sound to attract game.

name: Game trap
definition: Snare, leg-hold or body-grip trap made for trapping game or fur animals. Mouse, rat, insect and live-catch cage traps are in Home Safety & Security.

name: Hunting blind
definition: Portable hide or screen that conceals a hunter from game.

name: Hunting rangefinder
definition: Handheld laser rangefinder made to measure the distance to game.

name: Speargun
definition: underwater gun powered by rubber bands or compressed air that fires a spear at fish.

name: Archery target
definition: Boss, butt or block made to stop arrows, with or without a target face.

name: Archery arm guard
definition: Guard strapped to the bow arm that protects it from the bowstring.

name: Archery finger tab
definition: Leather or synthetic pad worn on the drawing fingers to hold and release the string.

name: Boomerang
definition: Curved throwing wing made to return to the thrower or fly for distance, in every form.

name: Clay target
definition: frangible disc thrown as a flying target for clay shooting.

name: Clay thrower
definition: hand or machine trap that launches clay targets.

name: Pool cue
definition: tapered stick used to strike the balls in pool, snooker and billiards.

name: Pool table
definition: cloth-covered slate or board table with cushions, with or without pockets, made for pool, snooker or billiards.

name: Dartboard
definition: target board made for darts, of bristle, cork or electronic segments.

name: Golf driver
definition: lowest-lofted wood with the largest head, made to hit the ball off the tee for maximum distance.

name: Fairway wood
definition: wood with more loft and a smaller head than the driver, made to be hit from the fairway or tee.

name: Hybrid
definition: club with a compact wood-like head that replaces a long iron.

name: Golf iron set
definition: Matched set of irons of graded loft with flat-faced heads; the type is game improvement, players distance or blade.

name: Golf wedge
definition: high-lofted club made for short approach, pitch, chip and bunker shots.

name: Putter
definition: low-lofted club made to roll the ball on the green.

name: Golf ball
definition: dimpled ball made to the rules of golf.

name: Golf rangefinder
definition: Handheld laser rangefinder made to measure the distance to the flag. Golf GPS units are in Phones, Tablets & Personal Devices.

name: Upright exercise bike
definition: Stationary pedal machine with an upright seat and handlebar, the standard exercise bike; the resistance type varies.

name: Spin bike
definition: Stationary bike with a heavy front flywheel and a road-bike riding position that allows riding out of the saddle.

name: Recumbent exercise bike
definition: Stationary bike with a seat with a backrest and the pedals set forward.

name: Fitness trampoline
definition: Small trampoline (rebounder) with a frame of about 1.2 m or less, sold for exercise. A garden or play trampoline is in Toys & Games.

name: Rowing machine
definition: stationary machine that simulates rowing with a sliding seat and a resisted pull handle.

name: Treadmill
definition: Machine with a moving belt for walking or running in place; the belt is motorised or manual.

name: Kettlebell
definition: cast weight shaped as a ball with a handle, swung and lifted in training.

name: Weight bar
definition: bar made to carry weight plates for lifting (barbell or dumbbell bar).

name: Yoga mat
definition: thin, non-slip mat made for yoga and floor exercise.

name: Metal detector
definition: handheld search coil and control unit made to find buried metal objects for treasure hunting.

name: Pinpointer
definition: small handheld probe detector that locates a find inside a dug hole.

name: Digging tool
definition: trowel, spade or knife made to dig out finds in metal detecting.

name: Bivvy bag
definition: waterproof, breathable sleeping-bag cover used as a minimal shelter.

name: Sleeping bag
definition: Insulated bag to sleep in outdoors; it carries a season or temperature rating.

name: Sleeping mat
definition: foam, self-inflating or air pad that insulates and cushions a sleeper from the ground.

name: Tarp
definition: waterproof sheet pitched with poles or lines as a roof shelter.

name: Tent
definition: Portable fabric shelter pitched on poles or frames, including yurts and tipis. A platform built for one is in Property & Structures.

name: Trekking pole
definition: Adjustable walking pole used for support on trails; the grip is I-type, T-type or Nordic.

name: Badminton racket
definition: Light, long-shafted racket strung for badminton; balance, weight and flex vary.

name: Shuttlecock
definition: feathered or plastic-skirted projectile hit in badminton.

name: Table tennis bat
definition: Wooden blade, with or without rubbers, used to hit the ball in table tennis; the grip is shakehand or penholder.

name: Table tennis table
definition: Regulation-surface table with a net made for table tennis; indoor or outdoor models.

name: Tennis ball
definition: Felt-covered rubber ball made for tennis; pressurised or pressureless.

name: Tennis racket
definition: Strung racket made for tennis; head size, weight and balance vary.

name: Tennis shoe
definition: Court shoe sold as a performance model with a court-specific sole for tennis. An everyday tennis-style sneaker is in Footwear.

name: Padel racket
definition: Solid, stringless perforated racket made for padel.

name: Padel ball
definition: Pressurised felt ball made for padel, slightly less pressurised than a tennis ball.

name: Pickleball paddle
definition: Solid, flat-faced paddle made for pickleball.

name: Pickleball ball
definition: Perforated plastic ball made for pickleball.

name: Gymnastics balance beam
definition: raised narrow beam on supports made for gymnastics balance training and competition.

name: Gymnastics parallel bars
definition: pair of equal-height rails on uprights made for men's gymnastics and training.

name: Gymnastics uneven bars
definition: pair of rails set at different heights made for women's gymnastics.

name: Gymnastics horizontal bar
definition: Single high or training bar on uprights for swings and release moves; a kids' single training bar counts here too.

name: Pommel horse
definition: padded body on legs with two handles (pommels) made for gymnastics circles and swings.

name: Vault board
definition: sprung take-off board used for vaulting and gymnastics jumps.

name: HEMA chest protector
definition: rigid or padded chest guard worn under a HEMA jacket.

name: HEMA gorget
definition: rigid neck and throat guard worn for HEMA sparring.

name: HEMA fencing trousers
definition: Padded trousers or breeches made for HEMA sparring, with a puncture rating where given.

name: Fencing lame
definition: conductive jacket worn over the fencing jacket so electric scoring registers hits (foil and sabre).

name: Fencing glove
definition: padded glove with a cuff worn on the weapon hand in fencing.

name: Fencing underarm protector
definition: half-jacket worn under the fencing jacket on the weapon-arm side, rated to FIE 800 N where certified.

name: Fencing chest protector
definition: rigid plastic chest guard worn under the fencing jacket.

name: Fencing breeches
definition: knee-length protective breeches made for fencing, rated to FIE 800 N where certified.

name: Fencing shoe
definition: flat, reinforced shoe made for fencing footwork.

name: Jazz shoe
definition: soft split-sole slip-on or lace-up shoe made for jazz dance.

name: Character shoe
definition: heeled dance shoe with a strap, made for stage and character dance.

name: Air bike
definition: stationary bike whose fan gives the resistance and whose handles move with the pedals.

name: Recumbent cross trainer
definition: seated machine with a backrest whose pedals step back and forth, linked to moving arm handles.

name: Camping hammock
definition: Suspended fabric bed hung between trees for sleeping outdoors. A garden hammock is not in this category.

name: Sleeping bag liner
definition: thin bag of silk, cotton or fleece used inside a sleeping bag for warmth or hygiene.

name: Bothy bag
definition: windproof fabric bag that several people sit inside as an emergency shelter.

name: Table tennis ball
definition: 40 mm celluloid-free plastic ball made for table tennis; comes with a star rating.

name: Table tennis robot
definition: ball-throwing machine that feeds table-tennis balls for practice.

name: Badminton string
definition: string sold to string a badminton racket, by the set or the reel.

name: Badminton net
definition: net and posts or net alone sold for badminton.

name: Complete golf set
definition: packaged set of clubs, usually with a bag, sold as one product.

name: Driving iron
definition: long iron with a hollow or wide-soled iron head made to replace a long iron or hybrid.

name: Archery shooting glove
definition: three-finger glove worn on the drawing hand to draw and release the string.

name: Archery bow sling
definition: wrist or finger strap that keeps a bow in the archer's hand at release.

name: Ski pole
definition: pole with a grip, strap and basket used in alpine and touring skiing.

name: Climbing skin
definition: strip of mohair or nylon plush fixed to a ski or splitboard base for climbing.

name: Snowboard binding
definition: non-release binding with highback and straps that fixes a boot to a snowboard.

name: Snowboard boot
definition: soft or stiff boot made to fit a snowboard binding.

name: Cross-country ski boot
definition: light boot with a Nordic binding interface made for cross-country skiing.

name: Splitboard
definition: snowboard that splits into two ski-like halves for climbing and rejoins for descent.

name: Swim fins
definition: rubber or silicone fins worn on the feet for swimming, snorkelling or diving.

name: Snorkel
definition: breathing tube with mouthpiece for swimming face-down at the surface.

name: Swim cap
definition: silicone, latex or fabric cap worn for swimming.

name: Pull buoy
definition: foam float held between the legs for arm-only swim training.

name: Kickboard
definition: foam board held in front for kick-only swim training.

name: Kite control bar
definition: bar with lines and safety release used to steer one kite.

name: Kite harness
definition: waist or seat harness that hooks the rider to the kite bar.

name: Kiteboard
definition: twin-tip or directional board ridden while pulled by a kite.

name: SUP paddle
definition: single-blade paddle made for stand-up paddleboarding.

name: Foilboard
definition: short buoyant board made to carry a hydrofoil for wing, kite or surf foiling.

name: Hydrofoil
definition: mast, fuselage and wings fitted under a foilboard.

name: Surf leash
definition: cord that ties a surfboard to the rider's ankle.

name: Surf fin
definition: fin fitted to a surfboard's fin box.

name: Surf wax
definition: wax rubbed on a surfboard deck for grip.

name: Batting helmet
definition: helmet made for batting in baseball or softball.

name: Catcher's gear
definition: catcher's helmet or mask, chest protector and leg guards, as a set or piece.

name: Cricket batting pads
definition: leg guards worn by a cricket batter.

name: Cricket helmet
definition: helmet with face grille made for cricket batting and close fielding.

name: Cricket batting gloves
definition: padded gloves worn by a cricket batter.

name: Wicket-keeping gloves
definition: webbed padded gloves worn by a cricket wicket-keeper.

name: Cricket stumps
definition: set of stumps and bails, fixed or on a base, made for cricket.

name: Goalkeeper gloves
definition: padded latex-palm gloves worn by a football goalkeeper.

name: Football goal
definition: goal frame with net made for football.

name: Ice tool
definition: technical axe with a curved shaft and steep pick made for ice and mixed climbing.

name: Ice screw
definition: threaded tube screwed into ice as climbing protection.

name: Microspikes
definition: slip-on elastomer harness with chains and short spikes for walking on ice.

name: Kicking tee
definition: stand that holds a rugby ball upright for place kicks.

name: Padel racket cover
definition: Cover or case that holds one padel racket.

name: Pickleball shoe
definition: Court shoe sold as a performance model with a pickleball-specific sole. An everyday sneaker is in Footwear.

name: Electronic starting system
definition: electronic start unit that gives the start signal by sound and light in place of a blank pistol.

name: Elliptical cross trainer
definition: standing cardio machine with foot pedals on an elliptical path and moving arm handles.

name: Ice hockey stick
definition: Long-shafted stick with a flat blade, made to carry and shoot the puck in ice hockey; flex, kick point, blade pattern and hand vary.

name: Hockey helmet
definition: hard-shell helmet with chin strap made for ice hockey; sold alone or as a combo with a cage.

name: Hockey cage or visor
definition: face cage or clear shield that clips to a hockey helmet.

name: Hockey shoulder pads
definition: padded shoulder, chest and upper-arm protector worn under the jersey in ice hockey.

name: Hockey elbow pads
definition: padded elbow and forearm guard worn in ice hockey.

name: Hockey gloves
definition: padded glove with a segmented cuff made for skaters in ice hockey.

name: Hockey pants
definition: padded pants or girdle with shell worn over the hips and thighs in ice hockey.

name: Goalie leg pads
definition: pair of large rigid-faced pads strapped over the goalie shins and knees in ice hockey.

name: Goalie blocker
definition: rectangular pad on the goalie stick hand, used to deflect shots and hold the stick.

name: Goalie catcher
definition: large pocketed glove on the goalie non-stick hand, made to catch the puck.

name: Goalie mask
definition: face mask or helmet-cage worn by the goalie in ice hockey.

name: Hockey puck
definition: vulcanised rubber disc struck in ice hockey; mini and training pucks are variants.

name: Hockey goal
definition: steel-framed goal with netting set on the ice or floor for ice or street hockey; replacement net is a part.

name: Field hockey stick
definition: curved composite or wood stick with a hooked head, made for field hockey.

name: Bandy stick
definition: light slim stick with a long narrow blade, made for bandy.

name: Caving oversuit
definition: abrasion-resistant one-piece suit (Cordura or PVC) worn over the undersuit in caves.

name: Caving tackle bag
definition: round or oval bag with shoulder straps and drawstring or roll-top closure for hauling rope and gear through caves.

name: Caving descender
definition: bobbin or rack descender made for single rope technique in caves, often with assisted braking.

name: Caving cowstail
definition: short lanyard with a carabiner used to clip into rebelays and traverse lines on single rope technique.

name: Caving foot loop
definition: adjustable loop of webbing or cord that holds a foot ascender and the foot for climbing a rope.

name: SRT kit
definition: set of harness-mounted rope-climbing gear (ascenders, descender, cowstails, foot loop) sold or assembled as one single rope technique kit.

name: Carabiner
definition: metal snap link with a spring or screw gate used to connect rope, protection and harness in climbing.

name: Quickdraw
definition: two carabiners joined by a short sewn sling, used to clip the rope to bolts and protection.

name: Belay device
definition: friction or assisted-braking device that controls the rope when belaying or abseiling.

name: Camming device
definition: spring-loaded active protection whose lobes expand to grip a crack.

name: Climbing nut
definition: passive wedge of metal on a wire placed in a crack as climbing protection.

name: Piton
definition: steel spike hammered into a rock crack as a fixed or temporary anchor.

name: Bolt hanger
definition: metal plate fixed on an expansion or glue-in bolt to give a rope anchor point.

name: Climbing sling
definition: closed or sewn loop of webbing or Dyneema used as a runner or anchor extension.

name: Climbing chalk
definition: magnesium carbonate powder, block or liquid applied to the hands for grip.

name: Chalk bag
definition: small bag or bucket that holds chalk, worn at the waist or set on the ground.

name: Bouldering crash pad
definition: folding foam pad placed under a boulder problem to cushion falls.

name: Hangboard
definition: wall-mounted board with grips of set depth used to train finger strength.

name: Climbing daisy chain
definition: chain of loops or adjustable lanyard that links the harness to an anchor in aid climbing.

name: Climbing etrier
definition: short webbing ladder with steps clipped to gear to stand on in aid climbing.

name: Rope ascender
definition: mechanical clamp that slides up a rope and locks under load, held in the hand, on the chest or on the foot.

name: Climbing pulley
definition: sheave in a side plate that redirects or hauls rope, with or without a progress-capture cam.

name: Maillon rapide
definition: steel screw-link connector for permanent rigging of anchors.

name: Via ferrata lanyard
definition: energy-absorbing Y lanyard with two carabiners made for clipping along a via ferrata cable.

name: Climbing rope bag
definition: bag or tarp that holds the rope at the foot of a climb or when carried.

name: Climbing brush
definition: brush used to clean holds on boulders and routes.

name: Belay glove
definition: leather or reinforced glove worn to belay and abseil, protecting the hands from rope burn.

name: Caving ladder
definition: light flexible ladder of wire rope and alloy rungs rigged down pitches in caves.

name: Caving chest harness
definition: chest strap or harness that holds the chest ascender upright for single rope technique.

name: Caving undersuit
definition: thermal one-piece fleece or pile suit worn under a caving oversuit.

name: Goalie chest and arm protector
definition: padded chest, shoulder and arm protector worn by the goalie in ice hockey.

name: Goalie pants
definition: padded pants with thigh and hip protection cut for the goalie in ice hockey.

name: Goalie stick
definition: hockey stick with a widened paddle and large blade, made for the goalie in ice hockey.

name: Hockey neck guard
definition: cut-resistant collar or bib worn round the neck against skate blades in ice hockey.

name: Protective cup
definition: rigid cup worn over the groin, alone or in a jock or jill supporter, to protect it in contact and ball sports.

name: Hockey pant shell
definition: removable outer shell pulled over a hockey girdle to make full hockey pants.

name: Ice skate guard
definition: hard or soft guard fitted over an ice-skate blade to protect it off the ice.

name: Hockey shooting pad
definition: slick synthetic sheet laid on the floor for practising stickhandling and shooting off the ice.

name: Clip stick
definition: telescopic pole with a clip head that pre-clips a quickdraw or the rope to a bolt from below.

name: Cycling jersey
definition: close-fitting top with a full or part zip and rear pockets made for riding a bicycle.
